info.title: TCG Shop API
info.description:
Backend API for the TCG e-commerce platform (Yu-Gi-Oh, Pokémon TCG, One Piece TCG).

- **Authentication:** call `POST /api/auth/login` (or `/register`), then use the returned token via **Authorize**. Catalog reads, shipping rates and auth endpoints are public; `/api/admin/**` and catalog writes require the ADMIN role.
- **Money:** all amounts are in EUR and include VAT.
- **Errors:** failed requests return `{timestamp, status, error, message, path, fieldErrors}`; `fieldErrors` lists per-field validation messages for 400 responses.

post.description:
Only for orders in PENDING_PAYMENT.
- **STRIPE:** confirm `stripeClientSecret` with Stripe.js; the order becomes PAID when Stripe's webhook arrives. Calling again returns the same PaymentIntent.
- **PAYPAL:** redirect the buyer to `payPalApprovalUrl`, then call the capture endpoint.

fullName.description: Recipient name printed on the shipping label

isDefault.description: Make this the default address. The first address is always the default; the default moves only when another address is marked as default.

categoryId.description: Must belong to the same game

slug.description: URL slug, unique within the game. When omitted: derived from the name on create, unchanged on update.

setCode.description: Set the product belongs to (stored upper-case)

basePrice.description: EUR incl. VAT. Required for SEALED and ACCESSORY; ignored for SINGLE, whose price comes from its card variants.

releaseDate.description: Expected release date; required when preorder is true

stockQuantity.description: Required for SEALED and ACCESSORY; ignored for SINGLE (sum of its variants). For pre-orders: how many units can still be pre-ordered.

basePrice.description: EUR incl. VAT. For singles: the cheapest in-stock variant ("from" price).

stockQuantity.description: Units available. For singles: sum of all variants. For pre-orders: remaining pre-order allocation.

slug.description: URL slug. When omitted: the game's standard slug on create, unchanged on update.
URL slug, unique within the game. When omitted: derived from the name on create, unchanged on update.

parentCategoryId.description: Parent category for a subcategory; must belong to the same game. Null for a top-level category.

variantDescription.description: Summary of the card variant, e.g. "LOB-EN 001 · SECRET_RARE · NM"

unitPrice.description: Current price (EUR incl. VAT); null if the item no longer exists

problem.description: Why this line cannot be checked out, e.g. "Out of stock"; null if it can

shippingCountry.description: Country of the shipping estimate; null unless `country` was requested

shippingCost.description: Shipping estimate; null unless `country` was requested

total.description: Subtotal plus shipping estimate (subtotal only without `country`)

checkoutReady.description: True if the cart is not empty and no line has a problem

freeShippingThreshold.description: Order subtotal from which shipping is free; null means never free

paymentDueBy.description: When the order is cancelled if still unpaid; null once paid or cancelled

stripeClientSecret.description: STRIPE only: client secret for Stripe.js / Payment Element

payPalOrderId.description: PAYPAL only: PayPal order id, needed for the capture call

payPalApprovalUrl.description: PAYPAL only: redirect the buyer here to approve the payment

payPalOrderId.description: PayPal order id: the `token` query parameter PayPal appends to the return URL

addressId.description: One of the signed-in user's saved addresses; it is copied onto the order

variantType.description: Required for singles (the product's game); omit for other products

variantId.description: Card variant id; required for singles, omit for other products

quantity.description: Units to add to the cart

itemsReadyToShip.description: Order items moved from AWAITING_STOCK to READY_TO_SHIP

itemIds.description: Order item ids in this parcel; all READY_TO_SHIP items when omitted

stillPreorder.description: False once the product has been released

remainingAllocation.description: Units that can still be pre-ordered (the product's stock)

unitsAwaitingStock.description: Paid units waiting for the product to be released
